decisions.D1 family: pooled slope b_F = sum Re(G conj pred)/sum |pred|^2 over the COMPLETE L of the family; PASS iff |b_F - 1| <= 3 se_F (se_F from the noise model, frozen in expected_se, recomputed on the complete subset)
decisions.D11 GL2-type genus-2 products (T5g): half-phase slope within 3 se of 1 (pooled over the 2 curves); product phase |c_hat| <= 3 se
decisions.D12 pairs: mean of the 10 product-phase sums within 3 sd/sqrt(10) of 0
decisions.D2 all primitive: same over all primitive L; PASS iff |b - 1| <= 3 se
decisions.D3 H0: H0 (no main term) rejected iff b/se >= 5 (all primitive)
decisions.D4 lines: pooled slope over r = 2, 1/2, 3, 1/3 and all primitive L (line noise); PASS iff |b - 1| <= 3 se
decisions.D5 amplitude follows c: weighted LS of c_hat_L = Re(G conj(-eps))/(T2/2pi) on [1, c_L - 1] over all primitive L; PASS iff |beta - 1| <= 3 se_beta; H-c1 (beta = 0) rejected iff beta/se_beta >= 3
decisions.D6 root number eps = -1: pooled slope over the primitive L with eps = -1; PASS iff |b - 1| <= 3 se (H-noroot: -1)
decisions.D7 complex eps (T1): complex pooled slope s = sum G conj pred/sum |pred|^2; PASS iff |Im s| <= 3 se_im (H-conj: Im s = registered value)
decisions.D8 products M1: b = sum M1 mech/sum mech^2 over the 30 fields; PASS (mechanism) iff |b - 1| <= 3 se; H-prod0 rejected iff b/se >= 3
decisions.falsifier: the general law is falsified if the slope pooled over all primitive test L lies outside 1 +- 4 se (se = expected_se ALL), or any family slope outside 1 +- 4 se_F
